title: Analysis code for: The rheumatic pain care cascade across seven ageing cohorts
description: Python and R code for a cross-national analysis of the rheumatic pain care cascade (pain to diagnosis to treatment) in seven harmonised ageing cohorts: CHARLS, ELSA, HRS, KLoSA, LASI, MHAS and SHARE. Includes weighted and age-standardised cascade rates with cluster-bootstrap intervals, cohort-specific logistic models with DerSimonian-Laird pooling, functional-outcome models, the incident-diagnosis validation, sensitivity analyses and figure generation. No respondent-level data are included.
